readings.trading_window: steps with ts < 23:59:50 UTC; before the close = its last step
readings.time_weights: fast_simulate's: step i >= 1 carries (ts_i - ts_{i-1}) / 1e6 with its own q; step 0, dt = 0 and steps from 23:59:50 carry 0
readings.markouts: S(t) = mid of the last step with ts <= t; a markout beyond the file's last step is dropped and counted; R(h) over the fills whose markout at h is kept
readings.expected_fills: the orders resting after step i-1 at their distance from step i-1's mid meet dt_i
readings.q_c: F = the limit fills; C = every market close, the day's close and any §7 close inside the day (the author's decision of 2026-10-24, WO-HB3b; flag s7_close_in_C); P_post = W after the day's last fill

readings.pnl_split: exploratory: P_pre = fill edge + inventory over the window; a fill's S = the mid of the first step with ts >= its ts (the first step whose wealth includes it, unless the step clock is held; fills_at_step_ts counts the ties); a market fill inside the window is a third part (WO-HB3d)
readings.s7_afterwards: every step of the day (the realized path)
readings.shadow_replay: the whole snapshot file; the paper window ends at 23:59:50

qa_inventory.title: Q-A: inventory, P&L and drawdown before the close (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: Time weights as fast_simulate (each step's q after the fills before it, times the Δt since the previous step); the trading window ends at 23:59:50 UTC; P_pre and MaxDD in USDT for 100-DOGE orders (divide by 100 to compare with the replay, which traded 1 DOGE per unit). maxdd_logged_usdt is the bot's own drawdown column (a check). Flags: B3's mean |q| above B0's on that day; B3's q before the close <= -8 (PROTOCOL §9 Q-A).

qb_markouts.title: Q-B: edge at posting and at the fill, markouts and retention (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: Limit fills only (close == 0); ticks of 0.00001 USDT; m(h) = s(S(t+h) - p)/tick with S(t) the mid of the last step with ts <= t; a markout beyond the file's last step is dropped (dropped_h) and R(h) sums over the fills whose markout at h is kept. delta_*_mismatches count |recomputed - logged| > 1e-9 tick (expected 0).

qb_expected_fills.title: Q-B: paper fills against the expected fills E (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: E = Σ 1 - exp(-A e^(-κ δ) Δt) over the window's intervals and resting sides, A and κ from hb_calibration.json; the orders resting after step i-1, at their distance from step i-1's mid, meet the Δt to step i (fast_simulate's timing). An order cancelled inside an interval (a §7 pause) counts for the whole interval, as in the simulator.

qc_fee_curve.title: Q-C: P&L net of a maker fee f on the fee grid (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: P_pre - f F and P_post - f (F + C), USDT; f in %. s7_close_in_C: a §7 close inside the day is part of C (see the next table).

qc_break_even.title: Q-C: traded notional, break-even fees, paper fees and the close (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: F: limit fills; C: every market close of the day at its fill price rounded to the tick: the day's close (the 23:59:50 close, or the close of a position carried past 00:00; C_day_close_usdt) and any §7 close (halt or drawdown) inside the day, which s7_close_in_C flags (the author's decision of 2026-10-24); f* = P / notional in % (n/a for a zero notional); P_post: W after the day's last fill (its cash when the day ends flat, also if no step follows the close; flat_at_day_end); the paper fees are the ledger's 0.1 % (USDT fees plus DOGE fees times the fill price); a close's cost is its half-spread against the mid at its submission plus its fee.

s7_afterwards.title: §7 afterwards: when each loss limit would have triggered (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: The realized path of every step of the day; the notional at the cap is 1,000 DOGE times the day's first mid; net equity is W minus f times the notional of the limit fills up to the step.

qd_bot_counters.title: Q-D: the recomputed counts beside the bot's own day_end counters (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)

qd_pauses.title: Q-D: §7 quoting pauses and halts (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)

qd_exploratory.title: Q-D, exploratory: trade fills at the price, book and clock events (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: Exploratory (not in PROTOCOL §9). Among the opposite-side taker trades logged after a limit fill's order was posted and in the 0.5 s up to the fill, in whole ticks: through, one printed strictly through the order price; at_price (= engine_through + not_engine_through), none through but one exactly at it; no_trade, none reached it (a book cross at a clock tick, or a trigger outside the window). The paper engine fills on a print strictly through the order, comparing the Decimal price with the float print exactly, so an at-tick print can trigger a fill (engine_through) or cannot (not_engine_through). Book re-syncs: applied REST snapshots (clarification h); crossed or locked books from the bot's counters (its health rows stop at 100 a day); round-away quotes: clarification a.

qb_fill_classes.title: Q-B by fill class, exploratory: edge, markouts and fills over E (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: Exploratory (WO-HB3b; not in PROTOCOL §9). The limit fills by the at-price method's class (the table above), then all of them and the through + no_trade fills together; Q-B's definitions per class (ticks; R(h) over the fills whose markout at h is kept). fills_over_E: the window's fills of the row over E; for through + no_trade a sensitivity to the paper engine's Decimal-against-float comparison. Hypothesis, reported and not tuned on: delta_fill near +1/2 tick for at-price fills and <= -1/2 tick for no_trade (book-cross) fills; a positive delta_fill elsewhere would reflect the depth stream (100 ms batches) lagging the trade stream.

pnl_split.title: P&L split, exploratory: P_pre into fill edge and inventory (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: Exploratory (WO-HB3d; not in PROTOCOL §9). USDT for 100-DOGE orders, over the trading window: P_pre = fill edge + inventory (+ the edge of a market fill inside the window, a §7 close; none is expected). inventory = Σ over the window's steps i >= 1 of 100 q_{i-1} (S_i - S_{i-1}); fill edge = Σ over the limit fills of s a (S - p), with S the mid of the first step whose wealth includes the fill: the first step with ts >= the fill's ts (each step marks W over every fill booked before it, and a fill's ts never exceeds that step's; a fill at a step's own ts is taken to be in that step, which fails only while the step clock is held, as at a restart floor; fills_at_step_ts counts them). S is that step's mid, not mid_at_fill (Q-B's delta_fill). A day starts flat, so a fill before its first step enters step 0; the 23:59:50 close and a limit fill after the last window step are left out. mean_fill_edge_ticks: the fill edge per DOGE in ticks. Checks (within 1e-9 USDT): the parts' sum minus P_pre, and the largest |W_i - W_{i-1} - step i's parts| over the window; position_mismatch_steps: window steps whose 100 q differs from the cumulative fills (expected 0).

feature_shift.title: Feature shift of B3's normalized observation (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: z = the frozen VecNormalize normalization (clip 10) of each feature at each step of the trading window (the steps file's z columns); shares of steps.

shadow_vs_paper.title: Shadow replay against paper: the Q-A quantities and their PIT (descriptive; forward test; not pre-specified for inference)
notes: PIT = (#{m < m_paper} + ½ #{m = m_paper}) / 40 over the shadow paths (fill seeds 42 and 43 x 20 rollouts) of the frozen simulator on that bot's own snapshot file; flagged below 0.05 or above 0.95 (descriptive). PROTOCOL §9's PIT set is P_pre/100, MaxDD/100 and mean |q|; the near-cap share's PIT is exploratory; the shadow's q is at the end of the file, so it gets no PIT. P_pre and MaxDD divided by 100 (USDT per DOGE unit, as the replay). The paper window ends at 23:59:50, the replay runs to the end of the file. 5-95 %: numpy percentiles (linear interpolation).
